selection_priority_order: 4. Stability across source and session partitions
decision_rationale: BalancedSVM is decisively selected as the final research candidate. It delivers substantial gains in balanced accuracy (+2.76%) and error sensitivity (+8.25%), directly addressing the baseline's severe false-negative rate. Crucially, under the 29-source LOSO diagnostic, BalancedSVM maintains an even larger margin of superiority over the unweighted baseline (+3.28% BA, +9.28% Incorrect Recall), demonstrating that class weighting is robust to partition shifts.
